detailed_description:
The target video uses a premium Chinese-futurist concept-film aesthetic with restrained semi-anime influence, near-photographic material response, monumental negative space, sharp moon-white highlights, deep lacquer-black shadows, and cinnabar red as the only strongly saturated color. Motion is elegant but forceful, with every camera move synchronized to fabric, water, and sound.

[Shot 1] The video begins exactly from <Picture 1>. <Subject 1> stands almost motionless on the narrow obsidian platform, three-quarter profile to camera, with the pale moon-disc centered behind her upper body. For the first half-second only her loose hair strands and translucent inner sleeves react to a rising crosswind. <Subject 3> then lifts from its suspended arc and begins rotating around her torso in one clean clockwise sweep, never obscuring her face. The camera performs a fast but smooth 20-degree lateral arc from left-front toward her right side while subtly pushing closer. The reflected moon stretches across <Subject 2> as a thin ripple travels outward beneath her feet. A low silk snap, distant wind pressure, and a single deep sub-bass impact mark the ribbon’s acceleration.

[Shot 2] At 00:02.400, <Subject 3> passes extremely close across the lens and becomes a natural full-frame cinnabar wipe. The camera emerges into a close three-quarter view of <Subject 1> from chest level. Her gaze shifts directly toward camera for one precise beat while her right hand lowers and two fingertips skim the black water beside the platform. At contact, a razor-thin silver ripple expands across <Subject 2>, catching the moonlight like liquid metal. The camera drops rapidly by roughly thirty centimeters while rotating slightly upward, creating a controlled perspective surge rather than a handheld shake. Hair, sleeve edges, ribbon, and ripple all move in the same wind direction. A crisp fingertip-water contact, short metallic resonance, and rising air rush synchronize with the downward camera move.

[Shot 3] At 00:04.850, cut to a low wide shot from just above the reflective water. <Subject 1> remains centered but appears taller and more monumental against the moon-disc. <Subject 3> whips behind her in a broad S-curve, then decelerates into a floating diagonal line. The silver ripple from Shot 2 reaches the foreground and splits the moon’s reflection into several long porcelain-like bands while the actual moon-disc remains whole. <Subject 1> turns only her chin by a few degrees into profile as the outer black garment settles and the translucent inner layer continues drifting for a fraction longer. The camera makes a short forward glide and stops abruptly on the strongest silhouette at 00:06.700. During the final 0.3 seconds, all major motion nearly freezes except the ribbon tip and one final water oscillation, ending on a powerful clean tableau with no text.

overall_soundscape:
A deep nocturnal air tone continues across the full 7 seconds, layered with controlled wind pressure, realistic silk movement, subtle garment flutter, fine water resonance, and a low-frequency spatial rumble. Each major visual event has one distinct physical sound: ribbon acceleration in Shot 1, fingertip-water contact in Shot 2, and the broad reflective-water split in Shot 3. No voices, dialogue, crowd noise, or environmental clutter are present.

non_diegetic_music:
A sparse 7-second hybrid score built from one struck bronze-bell fundamental, a very low cinematic sub-bass pulse, and a thin bowed-metal harmonic. The first bell tone appears at the opening frame, the sub-bass impact lands with the ribbon acceleration, a tense rising harmonic carries Shot 2, and a final low resonant hit arrives at 00:04.850 before decaying into near-silence by the last frame.
